title: Who may sign in, and an administrator's admission changes
description: GET /api/v1/server/access lists both admission sources: operator (root's site.json, never removable here) and site_admin (runtime entries the broker keeps). A row whose account was created at a sign-in under a site onboarding configuration carries onboarding, that sign-in's receipt. POST /api/v1/server/access/lookup {login} resolves a GitHub login to its numeric id through GitHub's public users API; organisations and bots are refused (github_not_user), unknown names are github_user_not_found. POST /api/v1/server/access/add {id} admits the id, or restores a withdrawn one to its same account; POST /api/v1/server/access/remove {id} withdraws web access only. A change is in effect only when the reply arrives; 503 outcome_uncertain means it may or may not have been committed, and nothing is retried. Refusals are fixed codes shared with root's admin access CLI: runtime_admission_disabled, runtime_admission_full, admission_open, operator_owned, binding_drift, github_user_not_found, github_not_user, github_lookup_unavailable, broker_unavailable. Administrator, session and CSRF are required.

source.description: operator: site.json; site_admin: a runtime entry; none: only the gateway's deny remains.

state.description: allowed: admitted, not yet signed in; joined: admitted with an account; withdrawn: web access removed, the account stays; removed: a never-used admission was deleted (change reply only); denied: an unconfirmed withdrawal or leftover deny with no admission row.

actor.description: The administrator's GitHub id or root, as the gateway reported it; provenance, not proof.

last_seen.description: The newest use of any live session, accurate to a day: the gateway renews a session's idle deadline at most daily. Absent when no live session can tell, including one whose idle deadline has reached, or stalled within a day of, its absolute one and no longer moves.

denied.description: The gateway refuses this subject. True on a row that is not withdrawn means a withdrawal was not confirmed.

site_key_copy.description: The site AI key copy the site gave this person, at the sign-in that created the account or later by an administrator, from the gateway's own record: it says what was given, not what the person's Pi holds now. Only administrators' reads and the person's own read carry it.

suffix.description: The given key's last four characters.

current.description: The copy is of the key the site stores now.

receipt.description: What the sign-in that created the person's account did with the site's own defaults, recorded then and never updated. It says a clone was handed to the person's daemon, not that it finished, and holds no fact from the person's home. Only administrators' reads carry it.

outcome.description: no_access, check_failed: the gateway's own check with the sign-in token; queued, already_present: the daemon's handoff reply; unknown: that reply was missing or ambiguous; preselected: readable, and the mode only offered it in the chooser.

ai_key.description: The site AI key: seeded, already_present (the person's own credential stayed), failed, unknown (no reply), or not_offered.

mode.description: any: the installation admits anyone and the list is read-only.

runtime_admission.description: Root's switch; while false, add is refused and remove still works.
